headline: The Burnaby Entrepreneurs Gala
lead: Once a year we put on our best and celebrate the speeches, the awards, and the members behind them. Registration for the next Gala opens later this year — until then, look back at how the last two went.
note: Next year's registration isn't open yet. Attend a Wednesday meeting and we'll tell you first.

extras.heading: What to expect
extras.body: An evening of prepared speeches, awards for the year's standout speakers, and dinner. Dress code: business formal. Guests welcome.

extras.heading: Awards
extras.body: Speaker of the Year, Evaluator of the Year, Rookie of the Year, and the President's Award.
